work.title: Cut Change branches directly from the base
work.description: Change branch materialization so a branch is created from the current base tip without first committing a manifest projection to the base. Current flow: manifest projection commit on base, then Change branch. Target flow: current base tip, then Change branch. The cut still records createdFromCommit and baselineCommit.
acceptance: First stage start creates the Change branch from the current base tip
createdFromCommit equals the base tip used for the cut
baselineCommit equals the base tip used for the cut
Concurrent materialization of the same Work cannot create divergent branches
